say: Ennoda nel payir la kuzhai thandu karuppu aagudhu, blast maadiri theriyudhu. Nelvin-75WP podalama?
narrate: A Tanglish message from a paddy farmer: neck rot symptom, product named, spray explicitly requested.

out.reply: Nelvin-75WP is approved for paddy blast. Apply 200g per acre and wait 14 days before harvest. FICTIONAL DATA -- confirm with a real agriculture officer before spraying.

say: My tomato plants are not looking healthy. Some problem is there.
narrate: English message: crop named, symptom too vague to identify a pest.

out.reply: Can you describe exactly which part of the plant is affected? And what does it look like: yellowing, spots, wilting, or something else?

say: Thakkali la vellai puchchi irukku, Nelvin-75WP potu paarkalama?
narrate: Tanglish: farmer describes whitefly on tomato but proposes a paddy blast fungicide.

out.reply: Nelvin-75WP is approved for paddy blast, not for tomato whitefly. I cannot recommend this product for the problem you described.

say: Oru vishayam theriyala, leaf problem irukku, enna spray podanum?
narrate: Very ambiguous Tanglish: no crop, no symptom detail -- low confidence across all three questions.

out.reply: I am not confident enough to recommend a product here. This case has been sent to an agriculture officer. Please wait for their confirmation before spraying anything.
